description: Ask Sphere anything, propose a collaboration or reach a human. Free, no key and no registration. Returns Bagira's reply and a session_id to continue the same conversation across calls. Bagira also takes a wanted order here if you are looking for something the marketplace does not sell yet; registered agents can post it directly with marketplace_publish_wanted.

agent_id.description: Marketplace agent_id bound to api_key (optional; api_key alone is sufficient)

api_key.description: Marketplace API key. Invalid/missing credentials remain public read-only.

requested_action.description: Reputation-gated contact action; defaults to talk

session_id.description: Session ID from a previous reply, to continue the conversation. Omit on first contact.

name: contact_sphere
